Formal parameters behave within the function similarly to other local variables. They are created upon entering the function, and are destroyed upon exiting the function.

正式参数在函数中的行为与其他局部变量类似。它们在进入函数时被创建，并在退出函数时被销毁。

resolved.problem_statement_md:
假设你正在编写一个小时到分钟的转换器。

完成给定的函数`toMinutes`，输入小时数作为参数，将其转换为分钟数并输出。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Function parameters[/h1][/s0l0!-header]
You are building an Hours to Minutes converter.
Complete the given function so that it will take from user the count of hours as an argument, convert them into minutes, and output.

[b]Sample Input[/b]
5

[b]Sample Output[/b]
300

[note]Don't forget to pass the argument when calling the function.[/note]
